resources.string: Could not update storage usage. Try refreshing.
Content sizes are estimates. Database space may be reused later, so deleting content may not immediately shrink the database file.
Exported files outside the app are not included or deleted. Switching source accounts keeps local content.
Covers and illustrations saved for offline reading. Kept by cache cleanup; removed when their downloads are deleted.
Original files imported into the app. Cache cleanup and download deletion keep these files.
Image cache and temporary export or share files. Reading cache cleanup only removes cached images here.
Source state, settings, logs and other private app files. Kept during reading cache cleanup.
Delete all downloaded chapters, saved images and unfinished downloads, and stop their tasks. Keep reading cache, shelves, reading history and imported originals. External exports are not affected.
Remove temporary chapters and image cache. Downloaded chapters, required images, unfinished downloads and source state are kept. Cleanup waits until an active download or export finishes.
Download or export in progress. Try cleanup after it finishes.
Temporary chapters and images from reading. Clearing them keeps your downloads.
Device storage is full. Free some space before continuing.
This source reached its saved-state limit. Clearing reading cache will not reset it. Check or update the source rule before continuing.
Select a category to see what it contains and how cleanup affects it.
